scope: Explicit new mission/weather phase policy; legacy absolute wind remains unchanged and archived runs are never relabeled.
origin: Actual first PositionControl::setInputSetpoint consumption under shared PX4-clock mutex. Native receipt written AFTER that call, before clock can advance.
readiness: Native armed/OFFBOARD/flying and distance fromNED[0,0,-3]<=0.5m continuously before deadline; late/missing readiness fails rather than shifting request.
reference: 4801 preloaded analytic path samples, native sample-and-hold by floor(relative_phase/100ms), finite float32 controller reference. Every actual consumption records phase/index/effective position/velocity/acceleration/yaw after setInputSetpoint. Full table identity plus every native consumption checked; native controller query clocks may differ and are reported, not resampled or interpolated.
clock: Gazebo/PX4 boot source clocks integer microseconds; shared PX4 mutex prevents clock advancement between reference calculation and actual consumption. Per-run absolute origin may differ; common relative phase is the new declared policy.
weather: F(max(0,u-1s)) where F is unchanged bounded native kernel, u=(physical_source_time-native_actual_origin); before known origin useF(0). F has zero first/second derivatives at0, so initial constant and post-start curve joinC2. No reset or rewind of latent state.
weather_coverage: Every1ms applied physics force logs native source time/weather argument/vector. Full[origin,origin+480s] checked without interpolation. Earlier prefix samples remain and are checked against actual native origin after it becomes known.
landing: Request LAND after full480s; actual landing boundary is first native PositionControl consumption inAUTO_LAND, recorded separately. Retain complete actual mission interval, including terminal-reference hold pending landing activation; no crop to requested480s.
input_interval: actual native reference consumption start inclusive through actual nativeAUTO_LAND consumption exclusive; actual tail retained and reported. No metadata boundary substitution.
unchanged: legacy absolute40 and all prior success/failure
phase_comparison: Paired equality on declared full480s function and allactual consumption consistency; no interpolation, DTW, time-shifted actual vectors or intersection-only pass. Different actual vehicle feedback/response is allowed.
tests: 84/180ms pre-start transport/preparation delays do not change relative function
